title: Know more, share more
caption: Part 5: know more and share more. Your score from the book, share pictures, planning tools, languages and your account in ScoreMyBiz.
linkedin_text: Part 5 of the ScoreMyBiz tour: a score built from the book itself, sharing your score and your week as pictures, plans for a new shop or more sales, 25 languages, nineteen countries, sign-in with a WhatsApp code, your details and recovery, reporting a problem and downloading or deleting your data.
